decide_notification() is PURE (no I/O, no subprocess, no network, no LLM; AST import-allowlist test confirms only re/dataclasses/typing/__future__) and never raises on event content. Fail-closed AND always schema-valid: a malformed event (not a mapping, or event_kind missing/blank/non-str) -> critical, fully sanitized notify with a fixed summary + diagnostic code (raw content never echoed); an unrecognized event_kind -> critical notify (never a silent suppress); suppression only for the explicit _SUPPRESS_EVENTS allowlist. event_kind is capped to 200 chars and the dedupe_key to 400 so a clean-but-oversized event_kind/slice_id/source_ref can never produce a schema-INVALID intent. The input mapping is never mutated.

Secret redaction is machine-enforced, not self-attestation. A denylist of high-signal secret shapes (GitHub PAT gh[pos]_ / github_pat_, OpenAI sk- and sk-proj-, Anthropic sk-ant-, Slack xox*, three-part JWT, Bearer header, hooks./discord/slack webhook URLs, email/PII) is applied to event_kind, dedupe_key, summary (unconditionally) and diagnostics. The lookup value used for matrix/suppress matching is a separate stripped string that is never stored, so a secret-shaped event_kind collapses to the bare 'unknown_event' on the critical-fallback path. evidence_refs must be BOTH structurally valid (sha256:<64hex> or a safe repo-relative path) AND secret-clean -- a single-segment ref satisfies the path shape with no slash, so a secret-shaped ref is dropped rather than carried into the intent. decision_to_intent_artifact() re-verifies that every free-text field, event_kind, and every evidence_ref is clean before setting no_secret_payload=true; if anything is dirty it rebuilds with sanitized summary + dedupe key + event_kind, drops evidence refs, and collapses diagnostics to a single 'secret_guard_resanitized' marker. evaluated_at is rejected outright if it carries secret-shaped content.

Intent schema is tamper-resistant via 5 allOf if/then blocks: suppress (channels/audience empty, no confirmation, condition null); notify (>=1 channel/audience, condition enum); critical (channels minItems 2 + audience minItems 2 + requires_delivery_confirmation const true + delivery_success_condition const at_least_one_required_channel_delivered); high (channels minItems 2 + audience minItems 2 + confirmation const false + condition const none); info (channels maxItems 1 + audience const [peer_agents] + confirmation const false + condition const none). So a critical intent with one channel, a high intent with confirmation or without operator audience, or an info intent with two channels or an operator audience are all schema-INVALID. The 12 governor halt_reasons (run_governor.HaltReason) are mapped exactly, no abbreviation. Severity matrix: operator_pause_flag + all budget breaches -> high; clock_anomaly/usage_axis_missing/config_invalid/state_invalid/approval_required/consensus_round_budget_exhausted/drift_detected -> critical; consensus_required/mirror_drift_detected -> high; slice_closeout -> info.

Receipt schema (ao-ma-notification-receipt.schema.v1.json) is contract-first: AO-MA-11H-1 defines it but produces no receipts (AO-MA-11H-2 produces, AO-MA-11H-3 consumes). intent_ref is a structured object {path, sha256, artifact_kind, schema_version} so the executor binds a receipt to its intent by recomputing the intent's canonical-bytes sha256 (tamper-evident; intent_ref is never trusted on the consumer side). failure_code is an enum + failure_summary_redacted; delivered/failed/skipped if/then (failed requires failure fields, delivered/skipped forbid them). receipt_authority const delivery_observation_only; delivery_authority const external_executor_only.

Three guard flags (support_widening, production_platform_claim, live_adapter_execution) are const false in both schemas and in every rendered artifact; additionalProperties:false on every object. No GitHub write, no workflow/ruleset/CODEOWNERS change, no admin bypass, no support widening, no production platform claim, no live adapter execution.
